# Test m2 - footnote stripping
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-c', '''
import markdown

# Test 1: Footnote ref should be stripped from TOC name
md_text = """# Header with footnote[^1]

Some text.

[^1]: This is the footnote text.
"""

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc", "footnotes"])
html = md.convert(md_text)

print("=== TOC tokens ===")
for token in md.toc_tokens:
    print(f"  name: {repr(token['name'])}")
    print(f"  id: {repr(token['id'])}")

print()
print("=== Full HTML (first 500 chars) ===")
print(html[:500])

# Check that footnote ref number is NOT in the TOC name
assert "1" not in md.toc_tokens[0]["name"], f"Footnote ref should be stripped, got: {md.toc_tokens[0]['name']}"
print("\\nTest PASSED: Footnote ref stripped from TOC name")
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-500:])
print("Return code:", result.returncode)
